title: Why are sloths so slow? - Kenny Coogan
speaker: TED-Ed
zh: 【TED-Ed】樹懶為什麼這麼慢？ ——肯尼·庫根（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: In 1796, Thomas Jefferson received a box of bones he couldn't identify.
cues.en: In 1796, Thomas Jefferson received a box of bones he couldn't identify.
cues.zh: 1796 年，湯瑪斯·傑佛遜 收到了一隻不明生物的骸骨 又長又尖的爪子讓他想起了獅子

cues.text: A long, sharp claw reminded him of a lion, but the arm bones suggested a larger animal,
cues.en: A long, sharp claw reminded him of a lion, but the arm bones suggested a larger animal,
cues.zh: 又長又尖的爪子讓他想起了獅子 但牠的手臂骨頭看起來 像是更大隻的動物 一個大概三公尺長的生物

cues.text: one about three meters long.
cues.en: one about three meters long.
cues.zh: 一個大概三公尺長的生物

cues.text: Thinking it might be huge unknown species of North American lion,
cues.en: Thinking it might be huge unknown species of North American lion,
cues.zh: 傑佛遜認為這可能是一種 新發現的巨大美洲擬獅

cues.text: Jefferson warned explorers Lewis and Clark to keep an eye out for this mysterious predator.
cues.en: Jefferson warned explorers Lewis and Clark to keep an eye out for this mysterious predator.
cues.zh: 傑佛遜認為這可能是一種 新發現的巨大美洲擬獅 他特別警告了探險家路易斯和克拉克 一定要特別小心這種神秘的掠食者 但是這些骸骨並不屬於獅子

cues.text: But Jefferson's box of bones didn't come from a lion.
cues.en: But Jefferson's box of bones didn't come from a lion.
cues.zh: 但是這些骸骨並不屬於獅子 它們來自於已絕種的巨大地懶

cues.text: They came from an extinct giant sloth.
cues.en: They came from an extinct giant sloth.
cues.zh: 它們來自於已絕種的巨大地懶 史前地懶最早 是在 3 千 5 百萬年前出現

cues.text: Prehistoric ground sloths first appeared around 35 million years ago.
cues.en: Prehistoric ground sloths first appeared around 35 million years ago.
cues.zh: 史前地懶最早 是在 3 千 5 百萬年前出現 史前北美、中美及南美 有數十種地懶居住

cues.text: Dozens of species lived across North, Central and South America,
cues.en: Dozens of species lived across North, Central and South America,
cues.zh: 史前北美、中美及南美 有數十種地懶居住 與許多古老生物同時期

cues.text: alongside other ancient creatures like mastodons and giant armadillos.
cues.en: alongside other ancient creatures like mastodons and giant armadillos.
cues.zh: 與許多古老生物同時期 比如乳齒象 還有大犰狳

cues.text: Some ground sloths, like the megalonychid, were cat-sized,
cues.en: Some ground sloths, like the megalonychid, were cat-sized,
cues.zh: 一些地懶，像是二趾樹懶 大小和家貓差不多 但也有許多地懶體型巨大

cues.text: but many were massive.
cues.en: but many were massive.
cues.zh: 但也有許多地懶體型巨大 傑佛遜收到的骨頭屬於巨爪地懶

cues.text: Jefferson's sloth, Megalonyx, weighed about a ton, and that was small compared to megatherium,
cues.en: Jefferson's sloth, Megalonyx, weighed about a ton, and that was small compared to megatherium,
cues.zh: 傑佛遜收到的骨頭屬於巨爪地懶 體重約一噸 而大地懶的體型更加巨大

cues.text: which could reach six metric tons, as much as an elephant.
cues.en: which could reach six metric tons, as much as an elephant.
cues.zh: 而大地懶的體型更加巨大 可以達到 6 公噸 相當於一頭大象的體重 牠們漫步於森林及莽原之中

cues.text: They ambled through the forests and savannas using their strong arms
cues.en: They ambled through the forests and savannas using their strong arms
cues.zh: 牠們漫步於森林及莽原之中 強壯的手臂及尖利的爪子 可以將植物連根拔起

cues.text: and sharp claws to uproot plants and climb trees,
cues.en: and sharp claws to uproot plants and climb trees,
cues.zh: 強壯的手臂及尖利的爪子 可以將植物連根拔起 或是用來爬樹 牠們吃草、樹葉和史前酪梨

cues.text: grazing on grasses, leaves, and prehistoric avocados.
cues.en: grazing on grasses, leaves, and prehistoric avocados.
cues.zh: 牠們吃草、樹葉和史前酪梨

cues.text: In fact, we might not have avocados today if not for the giant sloths.
cues.en: In fact, we might not have avocados today if not for the giant sloths.
cues.zh: 事實上 我們今天能有酪梨可吃 還得歸功於大地懶

cues.text: Smaller animals couldn't swallow the avocado's huge seed,
cues.en: Smaller animals couldn't swallow the avocado's huge seed,
cues.zh: 體型較小的動物無法吞下酪梨的種子 但是地懶可以

cues.text: but the sloths could, and they spread avocado trees far and wide.
cues.en: but the sloths could, and they spread avocado trees far and wide.
cues.zh: 但是地懶可以 牠們將酪梨的種子散佈地又廣又遠 地懶繁盛地生存了數百萬年

cues.text: Ground sloths flourished for millions of years, but around 10,000 years ago, they started disappearing
cues.en: Ground sloths flourished for millions of years, but around 10,000 years ago, they started disappearing
cues.zh: 地懶繁盛地生存了數百萬年 但是在大約一萬年前 牠們開始漸漸消失 其他西半球的巨大生物也是如此

cues.text: along with the Western Hemisphere's other giant mammals.
cues.en: along with the Western Hemisphere's other giant mammals.
cues.zh: 牠們開始漸漸消失 其他西半球的巨大生物也是如此

cues.text: Researchers think that ground sloths could have been pushed out by an oncoming ice age,
cues.en: Researchers think that ground sloths could have been pushed out by an oncoming ice age,
cues.zh: 研究人員認為地懶 可能是因為冰河期而開始滅絕 或是因為和其他生物競爭而消失

cues.text: or competition with other species, maybe humans, who arrived in the region around the time most of the sloths went extinct.
cues.en: or competition with other species, maybe humans, who arrived in the region around the time most of the sloths went extinct.
cues.zh: 或是因為和其他生物競爭而消失 地懶的競爭對手可能是人類 人類正好是在大部份 地懶消失的時期出現 一些體型較小的樹懶存活了下來

cues.text: Some of the smaller sloths did survive and migrated to the treetops.
cues.en: Some of the smaller sloths did survive and migrated to the treetops.
cues.zh: 一些體型較小的樹懶存活了下來 並且遷移到樹梢生活

cues.text: Today, there are six species left living in the rainforest canopies
cues.en: Today, there are six species left living in the rainforest canopies
cues.zh: 並且遷移到樹梢生活 時至今日，仍有六種樹懶 生活在中美及南美的 熱帶雨林林冠之中

cues.text: of Central and South America.
cues.en: of Central and South America.
cues.zh: 生活在中美及南美的 熱帶雨林林冠之中 在樹上生活可以避開掠食者

cues.text: Hanging out in the trees is a good way to avoid predators, and there are plenty of leaves to eat.
cues.en: Hanging out in the trees is a good way to avoid predators, and there are plenty of leaves to eat.
cues.zh: 在樹上生活可以避開掠食者 而且還有很多樹葉可吃 不過這種飲食習慣也有缺點

cues.text: But this diet has its drawbacks.
cues.en: But this diet has its drawbacks.
cues.zh: 不過這種飲食習慣也有缺點 動物透過從食物攝取的 能量供自己移動、

cues.text: Animals extract energy from food and use that energy to move around,
cues.en: Animals extract energy from food and use that energy to move around,
cues.zh: 動物透過從食物攝取的 能量供自己移動、 維持體溫、

cues.text: maintain their body temperature, keep their organs working, and all the other activities necessary for survival.
cues.en: maintain their body temperature, keep their organs working, and all the other activities necessary for survival.
cues.zh: 維持體溫、 使器官正常運作、 以及其他所有生存必須的活動 但樹葉含有的能量少之又少

cues.text: But leaves don't contain much energy, and that which they do have is tough to extract.
cues.en: But leaves don't contain much energy, and that which they do have is tough to extract.
cues.zh: 但樹葉含有的能量少之又少 而樹葉之中僅有的能量 也很難被攝取利用 大部分的草食動物除了樹葉以外

cues.text: Most herbivores supplement a leafy diet with higher energy foods
cues.en: Most herbivores supplement a leafy diet with higher energy foods
cues.zh: 大部分的草食動物除了樹葉以外 還會補充高能量的食物

cues.text: like fruit and seeds.
cues.en: like fruit and seeds.
cues.zh: 還會補充高能量的食物 像是種子還有水果 但是樹懶，尤其三趾樹懶

cues.text: But sloths, especially three-toed sloths, rely on leaves almost exclusively.
cues.en: But sloths, especially three-toed sloths, rely on leaves almost exclusively.
cues.zh: 但是樹懶，尤其三趾樹懶 幾乎完全只吃樹葉而已 牠們演化出了專門 應付這種飲食的策略

cues.text: They've evolved finely tuned strategies for coping with this restricted diet.
cues.en: They've evolved finely tuned strategies for coping with this restricted diet.
cues.zh: 牠們演化出了專門 應付這種飲食的策略

cues.text: First, they extract as much energy from their food as possible.
cues.en: First, they extract as much energy from their food as possible.
cues.zh: 首先 牠們盡量從樹葉中攝取足夠的能量 樹懶的胃佔了身體的三分之一

cues.text: Sloths have a multi-chambered stomach that takes up a third of their body,
cues.en: Sloths have a multi-chambered stomach that takes up a third of their body,
cues.zh: 樹懶的胃佔了身體的三分之一 而且有許多隔間

cues.text: and depending on the species, they can spend five to seven days, or even weeks, processing a meal.
cues.en: and depending on the species, they can spend five to seven days, or even weeks, processing a meal.
cues.zh: 而且有許多隔間 根據品種的不同 樹懶可以花上五至七天 甚至是數週 來消化胃裡的食物 另一個策略就是減少能量的消耗

cues.text: The other piece of the puzzle is to use as little energy as possible.
cues.en: The other piece of the puzzle is to use as little energy as possible.
cues.zh: 另一個策略就是減少能量的消耗 其中一個達成目標的方法

cues.text: One way sloths do this is, of course, by not moving very much.
cues.en: One way sloths do this is, of course, by not moving very much.
cues.zh: 其中一個達成目標的方法 很明顯地，就是盡量少動 樹懶大部分的時間都在 吃飯、休息或者睡覺

cues.text: They spend most of their time eating, resting, or sleeping.
cues.en: They spend most of their time eating, resting, or sleeping.
cues.zh: 樹懶大部分的時間都在 吃飯、休息或者睡覺 牠們一個禮拜只會 從樹冠上下來上一次廁所

cues.text: They descend from the canopy just once a week for a bathroom break.
cues.en: They descend from the canopy just once a week for a bathroom break.
cues.zh: 牠們一個禮拜只會 從樹冠上下來上一次廁所 當樹懶移動的時候，通常都不是太快

cues.text: When sloths do move, it's not very fast.
cues.en: When sloths do move, it's not very fast.
cues.zh: 當樹懶移動的時候，通常都不是太快

cues.text: It would take a sloth about five minutes to cross an average neighborhood street.
cues.en: It would take a sloth about five minutes to cross an average neighborhood street.
cues.zh: 讓一隻樹懶跨越住宅區的馬路 會花上牠整整五分鐘

cues.text: This unhurried approach to life means that sloths don't need very much muscle.
cues.en: This unhurried approach to life means that sloths don't need very much muscle.
cues.zh: 讓一隻樹懶跨越住宅區的馬路 會花上牠整整五分鐘 這種超緩慢的生活步調 使樹懶不需要太多的肌肉 事實上牠們比其他體型相近的 動物少了 30% 的肌肉量

cues.text: In fact, they have about 30% less muscle mass than other animals their size.
cues.en: In fact, they have about 30% less muscle mass than other animals their size.
cues.zh: 事實上牠們比其他體型相近的 動物少了 30% 的肌肉量

cues.text: Sloths also use less energy to keep themselves warm because their body temperature can fluctuate by about five degrees Celsius,
cues.en: Sloths also use less energy to keep themselves warm because their body temperature can fluctuate by about five degrees Celsius,
cues.zh: 樹懶們也盡量減少消耗 在保暖方面的能量 牠們的體溫變化範圍 可以達到攝氏五度 體溫變化較冷血動物的爬蟲類小

cues.text: less than a cold-blooded reptile, but more than most mammals.
cues.en: less than a cold-blooded reptile, but more than most mammals.
cues.zh: 體溫變化較冷血動物的爬蟲類小 但是比大多數的哺乳類動物要大 這些生理上或者行為上的適應策略

cues.text: These physical and behavioral adaptations minimize the sloth's energy expenditure,
cues.en: These physical and behavioral adaptations minimize the sloth's energy expenditure,
cues.zh: 這些生理上或者行為上的適應策略 將樹懶消耗的能量 代謝速率降到最低

cues.text: or metabolic rate.
cues.en: or metabolic rate.
cues.zh: 將樹懶消耗的能量 代謝速率降到最低

cues.text: Three-toed sloths have the slowest metabolism of any mammal.
cues.en: Three-toed sloths have the slowest metabolism of any mammal.
cues.zh: 三趾樹懶的代謝速率 在哺乳類之中是最慢的

cues.text: The giant panda is second slowest, and two-toed sloths come in third.
cues.en: The giant panda is second slowest, and two-toed sloths come in third.
cues.zh: 大貓熊的代謝是第二慢的 而二趾樹懶則是第三慢

cues.text: Moving slowly has allowed sloths to thrive in their treetop habitat.
cues.en: Moving slowly has allowed sloths to thrive in their treetop habitat.
cues.zh: 緩慢的動作讓樹懶 得以在樹冠層棲地中繁衍昌盛

cues.text: But it's also made the sloths themselves a great habitat for other organisms,
cues.en: But it's also made the sloths themselves a great habitat for other organisms,
cues.zh: 但這也使得樹懶自己 變成了其他有機生物的棲地

cues.text: including algae, which provides a little extra camouflage, and maybe even a snack.
cues.en: including algae, which provides a little extra camouflage, and maybe even a snack.
cues.zh: 但這也使得樹懶自己 變成了其他有機生物的棲地 比如長在樹懶身上的藻類 能幫助樹懶偽裝 還能當零嘴吃

cues.text: Sloths may not be giant anymore, but that doesn't make them any less remarkable.
cues.en: Sloths may not be giant anymore, but that doesn't make them any less remarkable.
cues.zh: 還能當零嘴吃 儘管樹懶的體型不再巨大 人們對樹懶的興趣還是絲毫未減
